domains.label: Urinary
domains.router_description: urinary symptoms: trouble peeing, weak stream, hesitancy, burning with urination, frequency, urgency, leaking or incontinence, blood in urine, inability to pass urine, flank or suprapubic pain related to the urinary tract

domains.label: Respiratory
domains.router_description: breathing and lung symptoms: cough, shortness of breath, wheezing, chest tightness with breathing, coughing up phlegm or blood, noisy breathing

domains.label: Oral / dental
domains.router_description: mouth, teeth, gums, tongue, and lips: tooth pain, gum bleeding, mouth sores, dental swelling, dry mouth, jaw or tooth injury

domains.label: Musculoskeletal
domains.router_description: bones, joints, muscles, tendons, and back: joint pain or swelling, injuries, sprains, fractures, stiffness, back pain, limb weakness from musculoskeletal causes

domains.label: Head and neck
domains.router_description: head and neck complaints: headache, neck pain, neck lumps, sore throat, hoarse voice, ear pain or hearing loss, sinus or nasal symptoms, nosebleeds

domains.label: Digestive
domains.router_description: digestive and abdominal symptoms: belly pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, heartburn, trouble swallowing, bloating, blood in stool, yellow skin or eyes

domains.label: Cardiovascular
domains.router_description: heart and circulation symptoms: chest pain or pressure, palpitations, fainting, leg swelling, high blood pressure concerns, exertional breathlessness thought to be cardiac

domains.label: Neurological
domains.router_description: nervous system symptoms: dizziness or vertigo, weakness, numbness or tingling, trouble speaking, vision changes, seizures, memory problems or confusion, tremor, balance problems

domains.label: Skin
domains.router_description: skin complaints: rash, itching, hives, blisters, moles or skin lesions, wounds that will not heal, skin infections, reactions on the skin
